question: Which of the following is an example of indirect tax?
solution:
The correct answer is__** G.S.T.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **G.S.T. (Goods and Services Tax) is an example of an indirect tax because it is imposed on the final consumer, but is collected by businesses at each stage of production and distribution.**
 
• ** Indirect taxes** are those that are** imposed on goods and services** and are ultimately paid by the consumer, while **direct taxes are those that are imposed on individuals or entities and are paid directly by them**.
 
• **Gift tax** is a tax on the transfer of property by one individual to another, and is usually paid by the person giving the gift.
 
 
• Gift tax is a direct tax, as it is imposed directly on the person giving the gift.
 
 
 
• **Corporation tax** for firms is a tax on the profits of the company and is usually paid by the company itself.
 
 
• Corporation tax for firms is also a direct tax, as it is imposed on the profits of the company.
 
 
 
• ** Property tax** is a tax on the value of property and is usually paid by the owner of the property. 
 
 
• Property tax is a direct tax, as it is imposed on the owner of the property.
